entries.entry_name: Boss Separation — Hunter-Killer Negatrix and Positrox
entries.mitigation: Keep the Hunter-Killers split on opposite sides. Only bring them together briefly when you need their electrical link to break a sphere shield.

entries.entry_name: Sphere Shield Break — Hunter-Killer Negatrix and Positrox
entries.mitigation: Bring the bosses together just long enough to pass their link through the shielded sphere, then separate them again before the link pressure overwhelms the group.

entries.entry_name: Take Aim — Hunter-Killer Negatrix and Positrox
entries.mitigation: Interrupt Take Aim immediately. Do not let the cast finish on its target.

entries.entry_name: Poison Injection — Hunter-Killer Negatrix and Positrox
entries.mitigation: Cleanse or purge Poison Injection quickly and stay in healing while it is active.
Interrupt Pinnacle before the four expanding AoEs finish. Letting the channel complete turns a manageable mechanic into a group problem.
Get ranged from the steaming Centurion and avoid standing in the steam. Off-tank or kill the add cleanly rather than dragging it through group.
The upstairs team must kill the spheres, activate the four consoles, and return before the roughly 60-second timeout becomes a wipe.
Move the raid in front of Archcustodian and trigger the Shock Pylon when the boss reaches it. Burn only while it is stunned and the shield is down.
Tanks pull the two adds away from the shielded boss and face them away from group. Do not fire projectiles into a shielded two-hander.
Step out or dodge-roll through the blades. Blocking reduces the hit but does not prevent the bleed.
Stay in front of the boss and do not fall too far behind during the walk phase or the raid gets punished by lethal long-range attacks.
Swap Reactor and Reducer quickly when the bubble stacks appear. Ten stacks is lethal, so do not try to out-tank the mechanic.
Hard-priority the bombers before they reach the Reclaimer shield and become empowered.
Expect exploding adds once a boss reaches 20%. Kill them before they reach or empower around the Reclaimer.
Stay out of the claw zones. If caught, break free immediately.
Respect the ramping damage. Keep the boss assignment stable, maintain healing, and do not overlap unnecessary pressure during the burn phases.
Main tank returns to melee range immediately after the knockback. Do not trigger repeated double-stomps; three becomes a raid wipe.
Off-tank and clear the scheduled add waves before pushing into recharge or execute if the raid is not ready for an overlap.
Destroy assigned terminals during recharge. Every terminal left active makes the ending hit worse.
Use the center transition as a survival phase, not a damage window. Stay stacked for healing and avoid unnecessary exposure while the boss repositions.
Stop hitting Assembly General during recharge and kill the assigned terminals before the phase ends; the boss reflects damage during the recharge.
